templates.title: Paperclip
templates.name: paperclip
templates.description: Paperclip is an open-source self-hosted board for managing AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI. Assign work to agents, run them, and track cost and output from a single dashboard.
templates.note: Self-hosted board for managing AI coding agents

env.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
env.label: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
env.description: Session signing secret as 64-character hex. Paperclip refuses to start without it. This shipped value is a placeholder shared by every install, so you must replace it before real use. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

env.name: PAPERCLIP_TOOL_ACTION_SIGNING_SECRET
env.label: PAPERCLIP_TOOL_ACTION_SIGNING_SECRET
env.description: Signs agent tool-action approvals as 64-character hex. The server boots without it but every agent approval fails. This shipped value is a placeholder shared by every install, so you must replace it before real use. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

env.name: PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL
env.label: PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL
env.description: External address Paperclip is reached on. Sign-in callbacks fail unless this matches the address you actually browse to, so change localhost to the server LAN IP or domain and use the port your platform serves Paperclip on, for example http://192.168.1.50:3101. On Umbrel the port is 10201.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.label: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key for Claude Code agents. Optional: Paperclip runs without it, but Claude agents cannot.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.label: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key for Codex agents. Optional: Paperclip runs without it, but Codex agents cannot.

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.label: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Google Gemini API key for Gemini CLI agents. Optional: Paperclip runs without it, but Gemini agents cannot.

env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.label: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.description: GitHub token used by agents to read and write repositories. Optional: Paperclip runs without it, but repository actions fail.
